Sam (Eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on SOC2/ISO stuff — question about audit log exports and delegation for on-call: do we have an SLA for log export delivery for customers and a recommended role/delegation model for SREs? 
Rachel (Security): Short answer: export SLA is 'best-effort' today for hosted; we're working to formalize for Dedicated/Private. We're targeting an SLO in q3. 
Mike (SRE): What's the expected retention window for exported logs? We need to know for support playbooks. 
Rachel (Security): For hosted, default retention is 90 days in the console; audit exports can be configured to S3/GCS for longer. For Dedicated/private, retention is configurable per-customer. 
Anita (Product): Is there a prescribed pattern for granting log access without giving full KMS keys? Customers keep BYOK — we need delegation guidance. 
Jia (Infra): For BYOK we recommend a least-privilege role that can read exported objects but not the key. In practice we use short-lived roles + KMS decrypt gated by a key policy. 
Leo (Legal): Note: for some enterprise contracts we require key usage audits and key rotation proofs. We'll need a checklist for SOC2 evidence. 
Sam (Eng): Can we get a checklist? Also curious about programmatic export — is there a CLI/API? 
Rachel (Security): Yes — we have an export API. Example:
```
POST /v1/audit/export
{ "start_ts": 1680000000, "end_ts": 1682592000, "dest": "s3://company-bucket/redwood-exports" }
```
We will add code samples to the docs. 
Mike (SRE): For the SRE team: who owns the automation to pull exports for support incidents? We want an owner. @Anita can you assign? 
Anita (Product): I can own the initial runbook and handoff to SRE ops. Will create a ticket and link it here. 
officehours-bot: Recording + notes from the all-hands posted: https://redwood.company/notes/handsoff-2479994321 :white_check_mark: 
Sam (Eng): One more Q: KMS rotation — will we support in-place rotation for BYOK or require re-encryption? 
Rachel (Security): For BYOK we don't re-encrypt customer objects; rotation is at customer KMS. We'll surface guidance for key rotation proofs. 
Jia (Infra): Implementation note: for Dedicated we'll add an endpoint to verify key rotation timestamps so audit evidence can be pulled automatically. 
Sam (Eng): thanks — can someone @ me when the checklist and ticket exist? 
Anita (Product): Will share ticket ID here when created. ETA EOD tomorrow. 
Rachel (Security): Follow-up office hours next Wed 3pm PT for deeper BYOK/KMS runbook; will post calendar invite. 
Sam (Eng): perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
